title: The quotient by the I-power torsion submodule has no I-torsion (I finitely generated)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq R$ a finitely generated ideal and $M$ an $R$-module. Put $M[I^\infty]=\{m\in M:\ I^nm=0\text{ for some }n\ge1\}$, a submodule of $M$, and $M'=M/M[I^\infty]$. Then $M'[I]=0$: if $\bar x\in M'$ satisfies $a\bar x=0$ for every $a\in I$, then $\bar x=0$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma 05EB (lemma-divide-by-torsion, line 24042), part (1)
